title: ClickHouse connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One ClickHouse connector instance's settings: the HTTP endpoint, the database and table, the source's key-range partitions and its incremental cursor, and the columns the sink writes. The source is the native Rust task (SELECT … FORMAT ArrowStream). The sink runs natively in `loams_connector_analytics::clickhouse_sink` (CN2 Task 17, R17.2), which reads only `url`, `database`, `table`, `user`, `password`, `dedup`, `settings`, `timeout_secs` and `pipeline` and refuses any other key: a config carrying the source's keys (`query`, `partitions`, `cursor_column`, `key_column`) or the Iggy fallback's (`columns`, `batch_rows`, `async_insert`, `wait_for_async_insert`, `tls`) does not start the native sink. Iggy's clickhouse_sink, whose config loams-fabric renders from this same instance (design §33 §8 row 12; CN1 plan Task 10), is the sink's declared fallback. `password` resolves through the namespace's secret store (D189) and is exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

url.description: The ClickHouse HTTP endpoint. Loams House is itself a ClickHouse endpoint, so a House URL works here unchanged (CN1 Task 10).

password.description: The user's password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered Iggy config reads it from a mounted file.

query.description: A projecting SELECT for the source, when the route does not name one. The précis' warehouse-to-Elasticsearch example projects its ~15 fields here (CN1 Task 11).

partitions.description: Key-range partitions the source splits the read across (CN1 Task 10's clickhouse_source_arrow_partitions).

cursor_column.description: Incremental mode's high-water column (CN1 Task 10); without it the source reads the whole table.

key_column.description: The column the key-range split walks, and the sink's ordering key.

columns.description: The columns the sink writes, in table order; all table columns when omitted. The Iggy fallback sink's key; the native sink refuses it.

batch_rows.description: Rows per insert batch. The Iggy fallback sink's key; the native sink refuses it.

async_insert.description: Whether the sink uses ClickHouse's asynchronous insert, trading a flush for throughput. The Iggy fallback sink's key; the native sink refuses it.

wait_for_async_insert.description: Whether an asynchronous insert waits for its flush before acknowledging; at-least-once needs it on. The Iggy fallback sink's key; the native sink refuses it.

tls.description: TLS material for an https:// URL.

verify_full.description: Whether the server certificate's hostname is verified.

dedup.description: Native sink: send `insert_deduplication_token` (the batch's id) with every insert, the same on every retry. Its effectively-once delivery rests on it and on the table's deduplication window.

settings.description: Native sink: extra ClickHouse settings sent with every insert (`max_insert_block_size`, …), as strings.

timeout_secs.description: Native sink: the per-request timeout, in seconds.
